digest.component_or_area: LLM provider registry and model inference
propositions: infer_provider maps 'gemini' prefix to 'google_genai', a provider name absent from both pydantic-ai's known providers and ProviderSession._builders, causing runtime LLMConfigError when bare gemini-* model ids are used

model_classes._resolve_target composes qualified provider strings using infer_provider's result verbatim, so gemini-* ids produce unprovisionable 'google_genai:gemini-*' strings that fail at call time, not config time
anthropic_model._pai_model accidentally survives this defect via a private _PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX table that translates google_genai to google-gla, masking the breakage in one code path only
Fix: remap gemini prefix to 'google', the canonical pydantic-ai name for Gemini Developer API already present in both KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES and pydantic-ai's known names

AC1: bare gemini-* ids must resolve through infer_provider and _resolve_target to a provider name accepted by ProviderSession.is_resolvable; AC2: all values in _PROVIDER_PREFIXES must map to names in either pydantic-ai known providers or ProviderSession._builders; AC3: inference for claude-*, gpt-*, already-qualified, and unknown ids must remain unchanged
